nom: DIME Super Skin Toner with Witch Hazel + CoQ10

avis.texte: This toner is very gentle but works so nicely on my sensitive skin. I have had friends compliment my skin recently and I know it's thanks to Dime :).

I think while the product just feels like any other toner, the ease of how the product doesn't leave uncomfortable stinging is nice compared to other toners I've used. However, the lid itself is a little tricky to get open
Great product! Bought it wanting to try a different toner and ended up loving this one! This is my second time buying it and is my new fav product!
This is wonderful leaves my skin feeling fresh not dry yet hydrated
This toner makes my skin feel so good. I feel like it tones my skin well too.

I use this toner every day after washing my face, both morning and night. It's great! Just remember don't throw away that little plastic plug or it will leak when you travel or turn it sideways, even with the lid on (I learned this the hard way!)
It feels super refreshing but doesn't dry out my skin like every other toner I've owned. My face feels SO smooth and it's gentle enough that I can use it every day

I recently just added this into my skincare routine. I have noticed tremendously that the pores on my nose have become so much smaller and almost gone at least it's a very nice prep before I do the rest of my skin care. The stuff works very well. I recommend!!!!
This toner really helps make make my face feel extra clean after cleansing. I've noticed a reduction in my acne and pore size. Amazing stuff from dime per usual!!!
A good toner without all of the harmful ingredients. I even have sensitive, acne prone skin and so far, it has not broken me out at all.
I've tried other toners and nothing else compares to this one.
This is my 2nd time purchasing this toner and I love it! I suffer with enlarged pores and textured skin and this has helped settled it so much! No itching or irritation. My new go to!
This toner works great without drying out my skin like some do.
I've been using the skin toner for over two years. Feels light and refreshing on my face and has helped kept my skin clear and smooth.
Feels amazing finding a toner made completely of clean, natural ingredients. Makes my face feel super clean and fresh, and have noticed improvement in my pores since using.
Best toner I've used! I love the clean ingredients and gentle cleanse it gives.
This toner is amazing and I love how a little goes a long way! This really helps prep my skin to fully absorb all my dime products!
This toner has helped with the pores around my T-zone especially! It cleared up the blackheads around my chin and it didn't get rid of the ones on my nose but it did make them much much better!
This is a great addition to my routine. It's gentle and absorbs quickly without drying out my skin. Love it!
I love this refreshing, hydrating skincare toner that provided the perfect pure balance to my skincare routine
Has worked wonders for redness in my skin and has helped clear up breakouts!
Reasonably priced and feels like it adds hydration just before my serums - if i wait too long before applying i get dry - this toner adds hydration for sure.
The Super Skin Toner is great for my sensitive skin. Keeps my skin feeling rejuvenated and hydrated!
I use it every morning and night before my ritual. It softens my face and makes my pores look nonexistant. I will keep ordering it.
I hadn't used for a month or two because I ran out. Just started using again and it's crazy how much this helps my skin!
I have been getting the super toner for awhile now. I have notice a big change on how my skin looks and feels, not just from the super toner but from all the Dime products. Love them ALL!!!!
This has been friendly for my face. It doesn't dry it and definitely tones it in a nourishing way.
This cleanses without drying out. Always in my daily routine!
Works really well under my moisturizer and my skin feels and looks much more even!
One of my favorite products! Simple and does the trick. Reorder over and over!
Clear and eater consistency toner that leaves the skin feeling fresh and ready for lotion! Works great to clear out pores but does not over dry!

I was super disappointed when I got this product, because I have been looking EVERYWHERE for a toner without phenoxyethanol in it. I thought I had finally found one, because this toner does not list that as an ingredient on the website. But when I received the toner in the mail, phenoxyethanol is CLEARLY listed as an ingredient on the box I received! But it's not listed on the list of ingredients on the website. I was very disappointed, because I was so excited to finally find a product without it, since there are questions about whether this ingredient is actually clean and safe. Please update the website ingredient list so that it's accurate. Other than that, the toner would have been great. I just wish I'd known beforehand, or I would not have purchased. I love my other Dime products.
I've found this to be the best way to start my skincare routine. My face feels so much better, and more hydrated when I use the toner.
A nice step in my skincare routine, overall I've been happy with my results after starting a routine so by default this being a part of it I would credit it as working.
Feels my face leaving so clean and helps even skin tone quickly!
I love all your products & this is a refreshing product in my skincare routine!
I have dry sensitive skin and this leaves my face feeling soft and smooth!
I don't go a day without using this in my face care routine! I always have a backup for when I run out.

I actually really enjoyed using this toner in the warmer months, my skin tends to get slightly oily & congested, this was so nice and refreshing to use. I'm currently on my clean beauty journey too I love that this brand is not only clean but made by an esthetician so I know it won't irritate or clog pores!
I love the super skin toner. It works great for my sensitive skin and always leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed.
Are you old enough to remember "the tingle/burn" of toner in the '80s? How did we think that was good? No more tingling with this amazing product!

Meh, I didnt really think this was anything special. Its a good value for the price, but lasted about half as long as other toners I've purchased. I felt like my skin looked more irrirated and less clear while using that-but that could be anything, so I'm not completely blaming that on this toner.
Second time purchasing because I love it! Gentle for every day use and helps with the other skin care products.
I've been using this toner for a couple of years now through a few different seasons of life and it never fails me. Probably one of my favorite products
Many toners will leave your face feeling dry. This one definitely makes my skin feel hydrated and cleaner.

I love this toner. I used it consistently for a month and noticed a huge improvement in the texture of my skin and acne. I didn't get a refill because I was trying to save money and it definitely showed in my skin. This will now be a staple in my routine!
I love using my toner. It makes my skin feel so clean and fresh.
This product is a staple in my skincare routine, and my skin has truly transformed since incorporating it into my regimen. Being EWG verified is just another added bonus!
I have been using dime beauty for almost 2 years now and I absolutely love it!. . I dont trust my skin with any other brand!
This toner is great - it makes my skin feel super clean and keeps acne and blackheads away.
I didn't have a great skincare routine until I tried Dime for the first time. The toner is perfect addition to my routine. My complexion looks more balanced and hydrated.
this toner is by far my favorite ive ever tried. it feels so refreshing on the skin. using the Dime skincare has really helped my acne and hyperpigmentation!

The Super Skin Toner in combination with the Gel Cleanser has my skin clearer than it's been in my entire life (or at least since elementary school). I've been using it for over a year and can't imagine switching to another product at this point! I have PCOS and am nearly 40, so lots of potential skin issues that DIME products (+ nutrition & lifestyle) are overriding!

My friend gifted me this and it's amazing! Soft and I can already tell my skin is looking healthier and nourished, not dry like before! I will be ordering more and more of your amazing products! I use it in the morning and night!
Love using toner after washing my face. I feel like it sets the stage for the serums and moisturizer that follows. It makes my skin feel and look better.
I love using the toner after washing and before adding all my other products. It really helps prep my skin for my serums.

I recently switched to DIME's toner and wow I wish I had done so sooner. My skin not only feels clean when using it but I also notice it has some moisturizing features to it. I only want to use this toner going forward!
Toner is awesome it makes my face feel like it tightens up . I just wish the bottle was a little bigger it is always the first thing to run out .
love the clean feeling this provides my face as well as overall toning
I only use this toner and have it on repeat order. A small amount on cotton goes a long way and cleans the skin. Doesn't feel drying at all.

This toner is the perfect follow up to the jelly cleanser. It removes impurities and support healthy skin by brightening and refreshing your skin. An essential step in your skincare routine regardless of your skincare goals.

I have been a Dime user for over two years now and love every product. This toner is the best toner I've ever used. It leaves my skin feeling truly clean and soft. After using I'm ready for the rest of the products which now go on smoothly. The toner never burns your skin like some products I've used in the past.

Though I do love the feel and light scent, I was disappointed in the amount in the bottle. It certainly did not seem like the amount of liquid fit the visual size of the bottle. Let's just say that it only lasted three weeks. I will go back to Klairs as it felt eaqually nice, and lasted a couple of months (at least).
Love this toner! It makes my skin feel super clean after using! Make sure to use it both in the morning and at night after cleansing for best results

I'm always amazed how much is on my cotton round even after washing my face during these hot summer months. It definitely gives me ease of mind that my face is clean and it always feels so refreshed after using it.
This is my 2nd or 3rd bottle and I am in love!! This feels amazing after washing my face
Nice edition to my nightly routine. I feel like it gives me another layer of clean right before I hydrate and moisturize.
I'm satisfied with this toner. Seems to work well. About to place another order. I wish it came in a bigger bottle as I feel like I go through it pretty quickly.
I am always concerned about irritating my rosacea prone sensitive skin. None of the Dime products have done that! I will repurchase. Makes my skin feel refreshed and clean.
This toner smells great and leaves a clean feeling on your skin after. Leaves the skin feeling hydrated
I can tell a notice difference when I use this vs not. My skin feels so much cleaner and retains moisture better when I've used it.
I love this toner. It doesn't sting like some of my 90s favorites did. Very gentle and leaves you feeling clean without a film.
I love this toner. It feels so nice on my skin after cleansing. I have this product on subscription!
I use this daily twice a day after washing my face. I find that it does help prepare the face for any other product you use. It feels light and helps soothe my skin after washing. Love this product!
This product combined with the face wash is a great starter kit for those that are looking for one.
I love Dime Beauty products! I use the Super Skin Toner as part of my routine. I recommend you try their products!
I love using this toner after cleansing my face with the Gentle Jelly cleanser. It makes my skin feel clean and look great!
